rendererInfo.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (0x00002689) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

visualReview.scope: Fifteen source-reference/candidate side/oblique/top pairs, four changed Herring burst phases, six actual thumbnails, desktop and mobile layouts. Reference view is the app frozen-source render, backed by separate independent original ZIP/glTF equality checks.
observations: Body silhouette, UV patterns, and fin placement preserve source reference; no new visible surface fracture in inspected frames.
Herring body and caudal surface remain continuous across four quarter-cycle captures.
Six actual specimen thumbnails fit desktop two-column and mobile three-column arrays; no card WebGL contexts.
Eye source differences are intentional pre-existing R02 procedural eyes, frozen by user and unchanged in R03.
limitations: Internal review cannot assign user visual acceptance or establish biologically calibrated species behavior.
Blue source skin remains 512x512 and Colorful fish skin 128x128; no generated extra detail.
Picasso source species identity remains unverified.

performanceComparison.method: Same hardware and six-school sequence; 1440x950; 500ms warmup and 2500ms traces. Draw dispatch wall time includes driver stalls, not true GPU execution time.
performanceComparison.limitation: Legacy median improves 33.3 to 16.7 ms; p95 remains 33.4 ms. No guarantee of sustained 60 FPS across every frame or hardware. No LOD/source surface reduction; all original indices verified on GPU.

changedHerringSurfaceGate.limitation: Continuous finite strain is not zero stretching or animal biomechanics validation.

rejectedCandidate.reason: Repeated original instrument updates per school substep regressed frame time. Current uses one original instrument update plus drawing-pose interpolation only. Rejected evidence retained separately and excluded from current gates.
